title: Dock Within Battery Budget (Depth-Limited Search)
real_world_story: The robot has K battery units left and each corridor costs one unit. Before attempting the trip, the controller must decide whether the charging dock lies within the remaining budget, without searching deeper than the budget allows.

real_world_connection.input_represents: Rooms, corridors and the remaining battery budget K
real_world_connection.query_represents: The robot room, the dock room and the budget
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Diving along one route but abandoning any route longer than the budget

problem_statement: Given N rooms numbered 0 to N-1 and E corridors, plus a robot room S, a dock room G and a battery budget K, decide whether the robot can reach the dock using at most K corridor moves.
task: Return 1 if the dock can be reached within K moves, otherwise 0.
input_format: The first line contains three integers N, M and D with D = 0 for undirected corridors and D = 1 for one-way doorways. The next M lines each contain two integers u v. The final line contains three integers S, G and K.
output_format: Print 1 if the dock can be reached within K moves, otherwise 0.

examples.explanation: The route 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 uses 3 corridor moves, which fits exactly within the budget K = 3.

expected_algorithm.name: Depth-Limited Search
expected_algorithm.reason: DFS with a depth limit explores deep routes first but cuts off every path longer than K, exactly matching a battery budget; the dock is reachable within budget exactly when a surviving path reaches it.

complexity.time: O(N + M) because rooms are marked once within the depth budget
complexity.space: O(N + M) for the adjacency list and the search stack

hint: Run a depth-first search that stops descending once K corridor moves have been used.
No route longer than K can ever count, so the search tree stays small.
Answer 1 the moment the dock is reached; otherwise the whole budget is exhausted with no success.
real_world_takeaway: A depth limit turns a potentially endless exploration into a bounded battery check: the robot only plans as far as it can travel.
